# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `stable` MCP server pointing at Stable's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.usestable.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses a Stable API key supplied by the user as an `x-api-key` header (`${STABLE_API_KEY}`).
- Logo: Stable's mark from the `useStable` GitHub organization.
